Bruha Oakhide is a shield dwarf at the Basilisk Gate Barracks in Baldur's Gate during Act Three.
“
Oh darling - you've been hurt too? Shame what this city's come to.
„
— Bruha Oakhide

Involvement

Act Three

Bruha is at the barracks with her husband  Thatmatt Oakhide, looking to report an incident where Thatmatt was struck on the head and mugged. Unfortunately, the Flaming Fist are making them wait to be heard.

Idle banter

Bruha chats occasionally with her husband Thatmatt Oakhide:

  • Bruha Oakhide
    Ravengard's back, I heard. Bet he'll twist some arms, clean up the riffraff.
  • Thatmatt Oakhide
    Duke-types don't care what goes on in our streets.
  • Bruha Oakhide
    Ravengard's no upper-crust softie. He's in charge of the Fist, right?
  • Thatmatt Oakhide
    If Ravengard had trained the Fist proper, they'd be out catching crooks, not turning a blind eye.
  • Bruha Oakhide
    There's more Flaming Fist on the streets than ever - maybe they'll whip the place into shape.
  • Thatmatt Oakhide
    Nah. They're too busy 'visiting' Mamzell's guys and gals.
  • Bruha Oakhide
    They do that quite a bit, don't they? It's a shame.
  • Thatmatt Oakhide
    A damn shame.
  • Bruha Oakhide
    How's your head? That last mugger left a hell of a mark.
  • Thatmatt Oakhide
    Still attached.
  • Bruha Oakhide
    Har-har. We can come back another time, if you ain't feeling up to it?
  • Thatmatt Oakhide
    Nah, let's see what Portyr has to say - she claimed she'd look into it.
